findings.source: ResourceMetering.sol:147-149 usedGas = _initialGas - gasleft(); if (gasCost > usedGas) Burn.gas(gasCost - usedGas);  Burn.sol:18 while (initialGas - gasleft() < _amount) { ++i; }
findings.issue: The gas-burning loop is missing: the text tests 'initialGas - gasleft() >= amount' once and otherwise falls through to 'revert with Panic(17)', while the bytecode loops (back edge 0x3859 -> 0x383b, ++i checked) until enough gas is burned and then returns normally; a deposit whose gas limit costs more than the gas already used is shown as reverting.
findings.rule: GAS is not loop-invariant: a loop whose condition reads GAS (directly or through a value computed from it inside the loop) must stay a loop, e.g. 'while initialGas - gas_remaining < amount: i = i + 1'; never conclude 'condition invariant, so the loop only exits by overflow of i' when the condition contains GAS.
findings.verified: disassembly 0x3834-0x3861 (gas at 0x383d re-read each iteration, jump back at 0x3859); text_check run --per-selector 32: 0 differences because no sampled call takes the burn path

findings.source: Bytes.sol:48 slice's Yul copy loop (for { ... } lt(mc, end) { ... } { mstore(mc, mload(cc)) }); RLPReader.sol:246 _copy (for { } lt(i, _length) { i := add(i, 32) } { mstore(add(dest, i), mload(add(src, i))) })
findings.issue: The source's word-copy loops are printed as whiles, one with a bound expression of five terms that is just 'start + length rounded up', so the proof walk is hard to follow.
findings.rule: A loop 'mem[d + i] = mem[s + i]; i += 32' while i < n with disjoint ranges is the copy line mem[d len ceil32(n)] = mem[s len ceil32(n)]; simplify 'a + b - t + (a - t) % 32 + 32 * not((a - t) % 32)' style bounds to ceil32 forms.

Implicit: the calldata decode of bytes[] _withdrawalProof (1678), the zero-initialisation of new TrieNode[] arrays (rotated 'while idx - 1', P3), the copy of _data into the packed opaque data (1069, 1295, P7). proveWithdrawalTransaction (1500 lines) reviewed by structure; finalizeWithdrawalTransaction*, checkWithdrawal, depositTransaction, receive and the getters in detail apart from the burn loop. The EIP-150 check '63 * gas_remaining < 63 * _90 + 64 * gasLimit + 700 * 3600' prints 2520000 as '700 * 3600' (P1-like time-unit factoring of a gas constant).
summary: Mostly faithful with the trie/RLP loops present, but the Burn.gas loop of ResourceMetering is missing: the text treats the GAS-based condition as loop-invariant and shows a deposit that must burn gas as reverting with Panic(17); the source's word-copy loops stay obscure whiles.
